title: Pullback of coherent formal modules
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of Noetherian schemes, $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals and $\mathcal I=f^{-1}\mathcal J\cdot\mathcal O_X$. (1) For an object $(\mathcal G_n)$ of $\mathit{Coh}(Y,\mathcal J)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] the system $(f^*\mathcal G_n)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], with the pulled back transition maps, is an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$; this defines a functor $f^*:\mathit{Coh}(Y,\mathcal J)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$. (2) For a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal G$ [pqf-def-coherent] there is a natural isomorphism $f^*(\mathcal G^\wedge)\cong(f^*\mathcal G)^\wedge$; when $f$ is the inclusion of an open subscheme $U\subseteq Y$, $f^*$ is restriction to $U$, so $(\mathcal G^\wedge)|_U=(\mathcal G|_U)^\wedge$.
